My bean plot is very small, not even half an acre, so buying a bag of shop fertilizer is too much money and too much for this land. I will spread the compost and goat manure from behind my house before I plant, and I will use the bean seeds I kept from last season because they still grow well for me. My wife and children will help me with the weeding and harvesting, so I do not need to hire any workers. I depend only on the rains because there is no water pump here, and I do not spray chemicals on beans.
